Do It or Drink.text: Do your best celebrity impression or drink.
Pretend to be a news anchor for 10 seconds or drink.
Sing the chorus of your favorite song or drink.
Take a sip with your eyes closed.
Balance something on your head for 5 seconds or drink.
Whisper a secret to the person opposite you or drink.
Make an animal noise — if someone guesses wrong, they drink.
Swap seats with someone or drink.
Take a sip using your non-dominant hand.
Pretend to be a waiter and 'serve' someone a drink.
Make up a dance move — everyone copies or drinks.
Say something in another language or drink.
Spin around three times — if you stumble, drink.
Tell the group your middle name or drink.
Compliment the person on your right or drink.
Wear an accessory from someone else or drink.
High-five everyone in the room or drink.
Pretend to take a phone call from your 'agent'.
Give someone a new nickname.
Close your eyes until your next turn or drink.
Try to touch your toes without bending your knees.
Do five squats or drink.
Pretend you’re in slow motion for 10 seconds.
Wink at someone until they laugh or drink.
Pretend to be a DJ for 5 seconds.
Swap a drink with the person next to you.
Pretend you’re on a cooking show.
Show the group your best 'evil villain' laugh.
Take a drink with your pinky finger up.
Whisper the alphabet backwards.
Invent a handshake with someone.
Walk across the room like a model.
Pretend you’re underwater for 5 seconds.
Pretend to cry dramatically.
Make a toast to an object in the room.
Pretend you’re a bouncer refusing someone entry.
Take a sip while humming a song.
Hold your breath until your next turn or drink.
Pretend you’re teaching a class on a random subject.
Describe your day in the style of a horror story.
Pretend you’re trying to sell your drink.
Give your best evil glare to someone.
Pretend your drink is a microphone and sing.
Tell the group your dream vacation.
Pretend you’re in a perfume ad.
Walk backwards to your seat.
Pretend your drink is too hot to handle.
Say 'cheers' in three languages.
Pretend your chair is a throne and you’re the ruler.
